intro.title: Chinese Scholastic Assessment (CSCA)
intro.desc: CSCA (Chinese Scholastic Assessment) adalah sistem penilaian kemampuan akademik dan bahasa Mandarin bagi siswa internasional yang mendaftar ke universitas terkemuka di Tiongkok. Ujian ini menguji pemikiran logika matematika, sintesis ilmiah, serta kefasihan bahasa Mandarin akademik, menjadi tolok ukur utama untuk masuk ke universitas kelompok C9 League, proyek 985/211, dan mendapatkan beasiswa sarjana penuh.

crisis.desc: Banyak siswa masuk universitas Tiongkok dengan nilai memuaskan di Indonesia, namun menghadapi kesulitan akademik yang luar biasa. Mengapa? Karena standar penilaian sangat berbeda.

academicAdvice.text: CSCA admission thresholds are rising annually. Logic and mathematical application represent the general bottleneck for Indonesian students applying for full scholarships; starting early structured preparation is the essential path to top-tier institutional success.

gaps.title: Three Key Academic Gaps & Advice for Indonesian Students

item1.title: 1. Logic and space transformation gap in vector geometry:
item1.desc: Indonesian curricula focus on step-by-step plane algebraic solutions. CSCA demands multidimensional synthesis. We recommend targeted Chinese-structure mock sets to develop cross-disciplinary geometry skills.

item2.title: 2. Theorem-heavy with low transfer application:
item2.desc: While formula memorization is swift, students drop points during intersecting operations and system transformations. High-frequency deep logical path practice under test constraints is strongly recommended.

item3.title: 3. Terminology and scientific Chinese barrier:
item3.desc: Difficulty reading and parsing mathematically dense Chinese phrases. UPER provides custom bilingual Mandarin-Indonesian science lexicon sets to remove the translation hurdle.
